title: Repurposed mini PCs and an ARM set-top box as educational web servers: test script, test application, and raw data
description: Test script, containerized test application (Nginx, PHP-FPM, MariaDB on Docker), and raw measurements comparing three repurposed devices (a Ryzen mini PC, an Intel mini PC, and an ARM set-top box) as educational web servers over 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi. The data comprise wrk load tests at 10, 25, 50, and 100 concurrent connections for static and dynamic content, sysbench CPU scores, iperf3 throughput, idle-state logs, and wall-power readings at idle, medium, and high load. Code is released under the MIT License and data under CC BY 4.0.
